mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a strengthening supply side, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and starts to rise, it signals the beginning of a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and starts rising, but SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals a weakening demand side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS rises > 200,000 and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 2 consecutive months but SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
